A host run of the `folder-bytes` spec is owed. Leaf a6dc1cfa landed folder-bytes (commit ca467d0d4, in nightly 3353), but I haven't run it on the host yet.

The command is `bun scripts/probe-kit/run.ts folder-bytes`. It needs the host rather than a workspace, because the spec needs things a workspace can't run (AppArmor `bwrap-userns-restrict`). It should go from a worktree or leaf clone, with `CAWCO_MIN_FREE_GB=8` if disk is under 10 GB. It's on my step 3 list alongside `comment-delivery` and `caw-off`.
